entries.desc: abi version gate; the loader calls it at instantiate and refuses anything != 1
linear-memory offset for the host-written msgpack args; 0 = refusal
byte-level msgpack round-trip of the argument array
drive out (default 1), read in (default 2), drive low, read again
boot milliseconds via the out-param convention
three consecutive live snapshots (out-param landing proof)
delay(100) then delay(0xFFFFFFF8): pins the host budget-cap refusal (no u32 wrap bypass)
stream_send an 8-byte sample (host stamps ch=2 + module name)
self-configure SPI loopback (sclk=14, mosi=12, miso=13, 1MHz, mode 0, CS-less) + full-duplex 8B
spi_config(no_cs=0): a CS bus is refused at abi=1 (negative proof of the host exception face)
camera_info probe + one QVGA RGB565 frame; the camera must already be on (caller's responsibility)

auxiliary.note: wamrc xtensa/esp32s3 output, hash-recorded for provenance. NOT deployable on the current board stack: the loader honestly refuses .aot execution (upstream ESP32-S3 AOT-in-PSRAM defect). Future-ready; never listed in index.json files[].
